description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Enablement Operations Manager at GitLab, you will run the operational engine behind global Enablement programs, events, and systems. You will turn program plans into clear timelines, logistics, communications, and repeatable processes so the field gets a consistent, well-run experience.

This role is hands-on with GitLab's largest Enablement-led events, including Revenue Kick-Off (RKO), GitLab Academy Bootcamps, President's Club (P-Club), and in-person workshops. You will also own Field Communications and the Enablement PMO and track how programs perform.

You will work closely with Enablement leaders and program owners, Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Workplace, and travel partners. This is a strong fit for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, calm under deadline pressure, and energized by making complex global programs run smoothly in an all-remote environment.

What You'll Do

  • Own Field Communications for Enablement, including the communications calendar, field newsletters, Slack and email announcements, and launch messaging, so the field gets clear, timely, and consistent updates.
  • Own the Enablement PMO, including program intake, the Enablement roadmap and calendar, prioritization inputs, project status tracking, and regular reporting to Enablement leadership.
  • Manage end-to-end operational planning and execution for Enablement-led events such as RKO, Academy Bootcamps, P-Club, and in-person workshops, from timelines and project plans through day-of execution and post-event follow-up.
  • Coordinate event logistics, including venue and virtual setup, hotel and travel coordination, registration workflows, attendee communications, session scheduling, run-of-show, and materials.
  • Work with vendors, Procurement, and Finance on quotes, contracts, purchase requests, invoices, and budget tracking for Enablement programs and events.
  • Run the day-to-day operating rhythm for Field Enablement programs, including program calendars, intake requests, cohort and enrollment operations, reminders, and status updates.
  • Use and improve templates, playbooks, and checklists so recurring events and programs are delivered consistently across regions.
  • Track participation, attendance, completion, and event feedback, and prepare clear readouts for Enablement leadership and program owners.
  • Keep standard operating procedures, planning documents, and handbook pages current so work is transparent and easy to hand off.
  • Spot operational risks and friction early, escalate when needed, and recommend practical fixes that improve quality and speed.
  • Use AI tools to streamline repeatable operational work such as communications, tracking, and reporting, and share what works with the team.
  • Partner with Enablement program owners, Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Workplace, and travel partners to keep deliverables on track.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience in enablement operations, sales or revenue operations, program management, event operations, or a related function, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • A track record of planning and executing in-person, virtual, or hybrid events with many moving parts and firm deadlines.
  • Strong project management skills: building plans, tracking dependencies, and driving follow-through with distributed stakeholders.
  • Experience writing and editing communications for a broad internal audience, such as sales or field teams.
  • Clear written communication, with the ability to produce attendee communications, process documentation, and stakeholder updates.
  • Close attention to detail and sound judgment when managing budgets, vendors, and high-visibility logistics.
  • Ability to bring structure to loosely defined requests and prioritize across competing deadlines.
  • Experience running internal or field communications, or a program management office (PMO), including intake, prioritization, and status reporting across multiple workstreams.
  • Comfort working in an all-remote, asynchronous environment across time zones, including occasional travel to support events.
  • Ability to learn and use GitLab effectively in day-to-day work and align with GitLab values.
  • Experience supporting field enablement, sales training, or other revenue-facing programs at global scale.
  • Experience working with hotels, venues, destination management companies, or event agencies, including room blocks and contracts.
  • Familiarity with learning management systems, content platforms, and AI-powered tools such as Gong, Cornerstone, Salesforce, Glean, or similar systems.
  • Experience building dashboards or reports on program participation and outcomes.
  • Experience improving operations through templates, automation, or tooling changes.
  • Experience supporting international events, including visa letters, travel coordination, and regional considerations.
Remot-Global

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range
$145,600—$218,400 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave 

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
